name: Dindigul biryani paste
ingredients_raw: Masala Paste: Onion (32%), Water, Refined Sunflower Oil, Tomato (11%), Curd (7%), Ginger, Garlic, lodized Salt, Spices (Red Chilli, Cinnamon, Star Anise, Clove, Cardamom, Black Pepper, Bay Leaf, Stone Flower), Green Chilli, Mint Leaves, Coriander Leaves, Lime Juice. Oil: Spice Extracts, Refined Sunflower Oil, Mono & Diglycerides of Fatty Acid (INS 471).
